subject.title: fix(tlon): bound urbit scry JSON response reads

question: Should Tlon scry success responses adopt the shared 16 MiB fail-closed JSON cap once path diagnostics and real-path proof are fixed?
rationale: The code fix uses the right shared helper, but it intentionally changes behavior for any legitimate Tlon scry JSON body above the cap.

options.title: Accept Shared Cap With Path Diagnostics
options.body: Preserve the failing scry path in the helper label, keep the cap, and require changed-path proof before merge.

options.title: Choose A Tlon-Specific Limit
options.body: Ask for a different explicit cap only if maintainers know valid Tlon scry payloads need a larger budget.

options.title: Defer To Broader Sweep
options.body: Pause this focused PR only if maintainers prefer resolving it together with the broader response-bounding work.

recommendation.title: Accept Shared Cap With Path Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Preserve the failing scry path in the helper label, keep the cap, and require changed-path proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and co-authored the landed hardening batch that currently owns this Tlon/helper boundary.
